\begin{example} \end{example}[The Angle Coordinate Vector Field on the Circle]

1. ch8:8.4If $\theta $ and $\widetilde\theta $ are angle coordinates on $\mathbb {S}^1$, then locally $\widetilde\theta -\theta $ is constant, so $d/d\theta =d/d\widetilde\theta $ on overlapping domains. These local fields therefore define a global smooth vector field on $\mathbb {S}^1$, denoted $d/d\theta $. \end{example}
